column2: Scientists Want To Make A Smart Toilet That Analyses Urine To Predict The Onset Of Diseases
column8: With the advancement in technology, we're seeing a lot of smart devices -- smart TVs, smart speakers, smart fitness bands, even smart homes! However now, some researchers want to bring these smarts to our toilets.  The Coon Research Group (from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and the Morgridge Institute for Research) is creating a smart toilet that will constantly analyse urine that is passed through it, to check for health issues.
